artworks.title: Title Page for "The Life of the Virgin in Emblems"
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.4 cm (2 3/8 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page with decorative elements. The main content centers around a large oval shape bordered by beads, within which text in Latin reads, "VITA BEATAE MARIAE VIR: MATRIS DEI EMBLEMATIB.' DELINEATA." The text is flanked by several small, circular illustrations depicting various scenes: a fortified structure, a ship at sea, a flaming urn, and a tower. The border features intricate scrollwork, and at the top is a small depiction of a figure. The bottom of the drawing bears the signature "Callot fec."

artworks.title: Salamander Surrounded by Flames
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.4 cm (2 1/2 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing features a fantastical creature in a stylized landscape. The creature has attributes of a large feline with claws, a long tail, and a dog-like face. The landscape includes a windswept tree on the left and a small structure on the right. Lines surrounding the creature suggest movement or energy. The style of the drawing is simplistic, focusing on line work to depict the creature and its environment.

artworks.title: Ship Navigating Near Rocks
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 8.5 cm (2 3/8 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed ship sailing on choppy waters, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The ship's sails are billowing as it moves through the sea. The horizon is low in the composition, with the ship dominating the scene. The style features intricate linear brushstrokes or etching, with a monochromatic color palette of sepia or warm beige tones. In the distance to the right, rocky formations are visible, while the sky is depicted with cloud and sunlight lines. Close by, rock formations create a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Dawn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a city in the distance, a starry sky above, and an owl flying. There is a tree on the right with small structures nearby. The scene is depicted with delicate line work and a monochromatic beige and brown color palette.

artworks.title: Eagle and Young
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a town, hills, and a large bird flying in the sky. The composition is divided by the horizon line. The lines are finely etched, creating a detailed appearance. The color palette is monochrome, using sepia-toned paper and dark ink lines. In the lower part of the image, there is a rocky formation with sparse vegetation and a tree branch. Sunlight is shown beaming through the sky.

artworks.title: Bird of Paradise
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.5 cm (2 1/2 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a scenic expanse with a low horizon, vast sky, rolling hills, sparse clusters of trees, and possible ruins on a hill to the right. The style includes fine lines for clouds and a mythical bird in motion with long tail and wings. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or brown ink on a light background.

artworks.title: Bunch of Grapes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 8.2 cm (2 3/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a central tree prominently featured, detailed with leaves and a cluster of grapes. In the background, there is another tree to the right, with hills and faint sketches of buildings or ruins further in the distance. The color palette is primarily sepia, emphasizing the intricate line work and creating a historical ambiance.

artworks.title: The Vulture
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with two large trees on each side, bushes on a flat horizon, open sky, birds on branches, delicate brushstrokes detailing the trees and birds, monochromatic color palette, and distant plant life blending the ground with the sky.

artworks.title: Two Palm Trees
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point of an island with two prominent palm trees in the center and slightly to the left. The trees' fronds arch gracefully, almost touching, creating a canopy effect. In the distance is a horizon line with hills, sparse vegetation, and possible structures or trees. The scene is depicted using a monochromatic palette of fine lines with delicate brushstrokes, detailing the palm leaves and textured land. The water reflects the island, with parallel lines adding movement to the surface.

artworks.title: The Gardener
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a man gardening, standing near a spade with a rake on the ground. In the background, there is a garden with plants and a lattice fence. A house is partially visible behind trees. The artwork is created using fine line work typical of etching, with a monochrome color palette emphasizing contrast between dark lines and a light background.

artworks.title: The Doe
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.2 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a horse with intricate line work for trees framing it. In the background, there is a hill or mountain range, as well as architectural elements resembling castle ruins. The monochromatic drawing features varying shades of brown with detailed brushstrokes and clear sky with wispy cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Oyster with Pearl
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing depicting a beach scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is low, the sea meets the sky, and a figure is seated on the water. On the sandy shore, there is a large open seashell and a smaller shell nearby. In the distance to the right, three figures are standing near a cluster of rocks. Delicate, linear brushstrokes are used to depict the scene. The color palette is subdued, mainly composed of sepia tones, giving the image a soft and timeless quality.

artworks.title: Rays of the Sun
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.2 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an expansive landscape under a radiant sun positioned in the upper left corner. The sun's beams stretch across the sky, with a low horizon. A suggestion of structures or ruins is visible on the left. The style uses thin, deliberate lines, likely from an etching process, with a monochromatic palette of black on a light paper base. In the middle, a vertical mirror reflects sunlight onto the ground, with a plant nearby on the right.

artworks.title: Man Washing a Pearl
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 8.4 cm (2 9/16 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a pitcher and a tray against a pastoral landscape. The scene features a solitary figure dressed in period clothing, equipped with a hat adorned with feathers. The character stands in the foreground on slightly elevated ground, pouring liquid from a pitcher into a tray. The background shows a serene landscape with hills, buildings, and structures.

artworks.title: Lioness and Cub Pursued by Hunters
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.2 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome depiction of a hunting scene. In the foreground, a feline is portrayed in motion, while another is further into the scene. In the background, there is a fence, and beyond it, three figures appear to be engaged in a hunt. The sky is lightly sketched with minimal clouds, and the horizon is marked by bushes and trees. The trees are on the right side with branches reaching upwards. The artwork features a simple line drawing style with consistent black strokes on a light background.

artworks.title: Dolphins and Crocodile
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.2 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three mythical sea monsters with serpentine tails swimming in a body of water. Their bodies twist and turn dynamically, with some appearing to splash or play in the water. In the background, there are landforms and possibly mountains or cliffs on the horizon. The drawing uses line work to depict movement in the water and the texture on the creatures.

artworks.title: Sheep Calling Lamb
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a raised viewpoint. In the foreground, there is an animal near a group of rounded trees. In the background, there is a hill on the right side with a small structure on top. The landscape includes bushes and rolling terrain. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia and brown tones. The use of detailed linework and cross-hatching creates texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Huntress
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.1 cm (2 3/8 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure with a staff and a textile, surrounded by playful dogs. In the background, there are hills, mountains, and trees. The style is linear and delicate, with fine lines detailing the figures and natural elements. The color palette is monochrome, using sepia-like tones on a light background.

artworks.title: Doe Mourning her Foal
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.1 cm (2 3/8 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a gentle rolling landscape. The horizon is visible with distant hills and clusters of trees. Tall cypress-like trees are seen along the horizon adding vertical interest. The artwork features fine linework in an etching style, with varied strokes showing texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using black or dark sepia lines against a light beige background. Two canines are depicted, one lying down and the other standing, framed by tree branches. Beyond them are undulating terrain and clusters of small trees, leading towards distant hills.

artworks.title: Lioness Mourning her Cub
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.9 × 8.1 cm (2 5/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog sitting in a landscape with a barren tree. The sepia-toned drawing portrays a dog seated calmly on the ground with its tongue out. The dog appears muscular and alert, sitting close to another animal lying on the ground. In the background, there are hills and bushes, and to the right, a leafless tree.

artworks.title: Turtle Dove Flying in the Desert
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.2 cm (2 5/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated viewpoint. A tree with intricate branches is on the left, with sparse leaves outlined in black. The horizon is depicted in the middle with a gently sloping hill and a few trees and a tall form in the distance. The sky has sparse clouds and a bird in flight. The drawing uses fine linework to depict the elements and a monochromatic color palette for contrast, giving a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Noah's Ark
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.2 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a large wooden ark on water, drawn with detailed lines. The background shows mountain-like formations. The sky features swirling clouds and diagonal lines. A bird holding a sprig flies above the ark. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a beige background.

artworks.title: Man Cutting a Balm-Tree
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.2 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a figure by a small tree or shrub at the center of the composition. The horizon is low with a wide sky, with a distant mountain and smaller trees visible. The artwork appears to be etching with fine lines, depicting trees and a lone figure. It is monochromatic, in black ink on a white or cream background, creating a classic feel. The landscape includes trees, hills, and structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Man Attending a Fire
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.3 × 8.4 cm (2 1/16 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure tending to a large fire with a stick. The flames are animated and dynamic, reaching high into the sky. The ground is depicted with simple brushstrokes, and in the background, there are hills with a structure on top. The horizon is defined by the hills, while the sky has minimal details. The color scheme is monochrome, using stark lines against a light background.
